categories.name: Surge Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched via Surge, a multichain "Internet Capital Markets" platform designed for AI-native startups and revenue-generating businesses.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Leveraged Token
categories.content: Leveraged crypto token is a type of financial instrument hat allows traders to amplify their exposure to the price movements of an underlying cryptocurrency.

categories.name: Farming-as-a-Service (FaaS)
categories.content: Farming-as-a Service simplifies the process of yield farming by handling the technical aspects, such as choosing the right liquidity pools, managing the staking or lending process, and optimizing the yield.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Echo Launchpad
categories.content: Echo.xyz is a decentralized launchpad that enables early-stage project funding.

categories.name: Arcade Games
categories.content: Classic-style games with simple mechanics, high replayability, and score-based progression.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: Argus Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Argus (https://argus.world/), the permissionless token launchpad native to Arc.

categories.name: Breeding
categories.content: Breeding games involve players using blockchain technology to breed unique digital creatures or items, represented as NFTs, creating offspring with potentially enhanced value and rarity.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: RWA Protocol
categories.content: RWA Protocol refer to protocol that facilitates the tokenization of real-world assets.

categories.name: Morpho Ecosystem
categories.content: Vault tokens within the Morpho Protocol.

categories.name: AI Agent Launchpad
categories.content: Platforms that allow users to deploy and launch their own AI agents.

categories.name: Appchains
categories.content: An appchain (application-specific blockchain) is a specialized blockchain designed to optimize performance and efficiency, tailored for particular tasks or specific use cases.

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.
